consequence.fileChange: It can create, overwrite or change the contents of files.
consequence.memory: What is saved can shape later conversations.
consequence.command: It can change files and run programs on this computer.
consequence.network: It can send information to a website and bring content back into the conversation.
consequence.externalTool: The server receives these arguments and can act on whatever it is connected to.
consequence.read: The contents it reads become part of the conversation.
consequence.helper: The helper works on its own with the tools this session has.
consequence.unknown: JAN cannot tell what this tool does. Check the technical details before allowing it.

scope.onceExplanation: Only this request. JAN asks again next time.
scope.threadExplanation: This tool, in this conversation, until you revoke it.
scope.alwaysServerExplanation: Every tool from {{server}}, in every conversation, until you revoke it.
scope.alwaysToolExplanation: {{tool}}, in every conversation, until you revoke it.

request.title: Permission request
request.chooseScope: Choose how far this permission goes
request.revokeHint: You can review and revoke permissions in Settings > Permissions.

pending.one: 1 request is waiting for your approval
pending.many: {{count}} requests are waiting for your approval

outcome.cancelled: The request was cancelled because the conversation stopped before it was answered.
outcome.cancelledNext: Send the message again if you still want it to run.
outcome.mcpNotTrusted: {{server}} is not trusted, so nothing was sent to it.
outcome.mcpNotTrustedNext: Allow the request when JAN asks, or trust the server.
outcome.mcpConfigurationChanged: {{server}} changed its configuration since you approved it, so nothing was sent to it.
outcome.mcpConfigurationChangedNext: Check the server's command, URL and settings, then allow the request again if it is what you expect.
outcome.mcpTicketRejected: The one-time permission for {{server}} was no longer valid, so nothing was sent.
outcome.mcpTicketRejectedNext: A one-time permission works for one call and expires after 5 minutes. Allow the request again.
outcome.policy: A rule in this project's settings blocks this tool.
outcome.policyNext: Edit the deny rules in .jan/agent/agent.toml to change this.
outcome.hiddenState: JAN's own settings folder (.jan) is never shown to the agent.
outcome.networkOff: Internet access is off for this run, so nothing was sent.
outcome.networkOffNext: Turn on network access in Settings > Agent Tools if the agent needs it.
outcome.domainBlocked: {{host}} is not a site this project allows, so nothing was sent.
outcome.domainBlockedNext: Add it to allow_domains in .jan/agent/agent.toml if it should be reachable.
outcome.secretFile: {{file}} looks like it holds credentials, so it was not read.
outcome.secretFileNext: Only if the agent really needs it, name that file in a rule in .jan/agent/agent.toml.
outcome.destructiveGit: This git operation ({{op}}) can lose uncommitted work, so it was blocked.
outcome.destructiveGitNext: To allow it, add a rule that names it to .jan/agent/agent.toml, for example allow = ["bash(git:{{op}})"].
outcome.unresolvable: The tool's arguments could not be matched to a file, command or site, so no permission rule could be checked.
outcome.writeOutside: The agent tried to write outside its workspace, which is not allowed.
outcome.writeOutsideNext: Copy the file into the workspace, or give the session write access to the folder.
outcome.approvalUnavailable: This kind of request cannot be approved from here yet.
outcome.reviewMode: The session is in review mode, which cannot change anything.
outcome.reviewModeNext: Switch the session out of review mode to allow changes.
outcome.folderDetached: The folder this session was working in is no longer attached.
outcome.folderDetachedNext: Attach a folder again to continue.
outcome.editNotConfirmed: Editing this folder has not been confirmed for this session.
outcome.editNotConfirmedNext: Confirm folder access for the session, or work in the session workspace.
outcome.accessUnsupported: The selected access mode is not available in this build.

settings.title: Permissions
settings.intro: What you have allowed tools to do without asking again.
settings.revokeEffect: Revoking only affects future requests. A tool call that is already running is not stopped or undone.
settings.conversationsDesc: Tools you allowed for a single conversation.
settings.noConversationGrants: No conversation has a standing permission.
settings.everywhereDesc: Tools and MCP servers you chose to always allow.
settings.serverAppOnly: Remembered by the app, but not by the part of JAN that enforces it. Its tools may still ask.
settings.serverChanged: Configuration changed since you approved it. This approval no longer applies.
settings.serverMissing: No server with this name is configured any more. This approval no longer applies.
settings.needsRenewalDesc: These approvals stopped applying. JAN asks again the next time one of these servers is used.
settings.reasonLegacy: Approved before JAN recorded which configuration you approved, so it cannot be matched to the server any more.
settings.reasonChanged: The server's command, arguments, URL, environment or header names changed after you approved it.
settings.allowAll: All MCP tools are allowed without asking
settings.allowAllDesc: Every MCP tool runs without a prompt in every conversation.
settings.revokeFailed: Could not revoke {{server}}. It is still trusted.
settings.loadServersFailed: Could not load the servers JAN trusts: {{error}}
settings.historyDesc: The last permission decisions JAN's built-in tools recorded, newest first. Secrets are removed before they are saved.
settings.historyEmpty: No decisions have been recorded yet.
settings.toolsEverywhereDesc: These tools run without asking in any conversation. Revoking one makes JAN ask again next time.
settings.noToolsEverywhere: No tool is allowed in every conversation.
settings.trustedServersDesc: Every tool from these servers runs without asking, as long as the server is still configured the way you approved it.
settings.allowAllOff: Off. MCP tools ask before they run, unless their server is trusted above.
